name: @observer-protocol/mppx-op-account
description: Observer Protocol delegation-credential enforcement for MPP / Tempo (mppx). A custom viem account that verifies a signed agent mandate against each session escrow and voucher at the signer boundary, fail-closed, before signing.

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --external:viem --outfile=dist/index.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --external:viem --outfile=dist/index.cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run fixtures && node test/run.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bash ../../scripts/refuse-dirty-publish.sh && npm run check:core-sync && npm run typecheck && npm test
